problem: Two identical bins contain chips. The first bin contains four green and two yellow chips. The second bin has three green and one yellow chip. A bin is chosen at random, and a chip is selected from the chosen bin, also at random. If we know that the selected chip is green, what is the probability that it came from the second bin?
